svg.title: Record a decision and bind its acceptance
svg.desc: This path follows an explicitly attributed decision through user-authorized acceptance. Remaining Proposed is valid. A status query and optional challenge are separate operations, not automatic authoring steps. Actual endpoint: The decision, decision-log append and exact acceptance binding are retained. Accepted/Planned does not prove implementation, verification or a merged PR. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Attributed decision → proposed record → accepted/planned binding

svg.title: Record the user’s choice
svg.desc: command: /ca:adr: attributed decision → skill: decision-lifecycle: index and author → skill: decision-lifecycle: decision log → skill: decision-lifecycle: accept on instruction. A numbered Proposed ADR and corresponding log entry. Acceptance waits for an explicit user instruction.

path.title: authoring owner: The command routes to decision-lifecycle for numbering, attribution and writing.
record the choice: The log entry accompanies the newly written ADR.
only on instruction: Stop at Proposed unless the user explicitly authorizes acceptance.

g.title: /ca:adr: attributed decision. Name the decision and the person making it. A routine finding or an unresolved CONFIRM item cannot be converted into an invented architectural choice.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: decision-lifecycle: index and author. Use the next unused number and full filename stem, gather rationale and governed paths, and write the current template with status proposed.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: decision-lifecycle: decision log. Append the matching user-attributed decision-log entry. A replacement names the full predecessor stem; it does not rewrite the earlier decision.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: decision-lifecycle: accept on instruction. Only explicit user acceptance advances status. Derive stable obligations and independently review the completeness of the sealed set before recording the binding.

svg.title: Bind a commit that exists
svg.desc: skill: commit-gate: accepted record → skill: decision-lifecycle: append acceptance → skill: decision-lifecycle: subsequent commit. A committed acceptance event points to the real prior source commit. Later implementation and verification require their own current evidence.

path.title: hash exact source: The source commit must exist before the binding can truthfully identify it.
append then persist: Persist the event without rewriting earlier history.

g.title: commit-gate: accepted record. Commit the accepted ADR and decision-log append through the normal gate. The acceptance binding is deliberately not added to this commit.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: decision-lifecycle: append acceptance. From the exact source commit, bind the blob, immutable record and sealed obligations in the append-only lifecycle ledger. A second binding for the same stem is invalid.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: decision-lifecycle: subsequent commit. Persist the binding in a subsequent commit. Later PR delivery must preserve the required source ancestry; an unqualified squash cannot stand in for it.
